metadata.gitb:name: eps-001 The system under test sends a valid European Patient Summary
metadata.gitb:description: The test bed waits for a POST of an EPS Bundle and has matchbox validate it against bundle-eu-eps. matchbox is the test bed's validation service (GITB REST API); its report becomes the report of the step.

interact.desc: POST the European Patient Summary to the address of the next step
interact.instruct: "POST the European Patient Summary (a FHIR Bundle, application/fhir+json) to the test bed, at the address shown for the next step, path /Bundle."

result.output: '{ "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "information", "code": "informational", "diagnostics": "Received. The test bed now has matchbox validate the document; the report is in the test session." } ] }'

verify.desc: matchbox validates the document against the EPS Bundle profile

success.default: "The patient summary is valid against the EPS Bundle profile."

failure.default: "The patient summary is not valid. Open the validation step to read the findings of matchbox."
